author: Stephen Covey
script:
Ek pal ke liye ruko.

Zara sochiye, aap subah uthte ho, hazaar kaam karte ho, raat tak bilkul thak jaate ho... lekin phir bhi lagta hai kuch reh gaya. Kuch adhoora sa. Aisa lagta hai jaise aap bahut tez daud rahe ho, lekin galat direction mein.

Yehi hai duniya ka sabse bada dhoka - busy hona aur effective hona, do bilkul alag cheezein hain. Aap busy ho sakte ho poori zindagi, aur phir bhi kabhi wo mukaam nahi paa sakte jiske liye aap bane the.

Toh sawaal ye nahi hai ki aap kitna kaam karte ho. Sawaal ye hai - kya aap sahi kaam kar rahe ho, sahi tareeke se?

Aaj se lagbhag chalis saal pehle, ek shakhs ne ye sawaal poocha - Stephen Covey. Aur unhone jo jawaab diya, usne duniya bhar mein karodon logon ki zindagi badal di. Unki kitaab, "7 Habits of Highly Effective People", sirf ek productivity book nahi hai. Ye ek philosophy hai. Ek nazariya jeene ka.

Covey kehte hain - success koi technique nahi hai jo aap seekh lo aur raatो-raat apply kar do. Success character ka natija hai. Aapki habits, aapki soch, aapke principles - yehi decide karte hain ki aap kaun banoge.

Ye kitaab aapko sikhati hai kaise proactive baniye apni zindagi mein, kaise apne goals define kariye is tarah ki wo aapke deepest values se judein, aur kaise dusron ke saath aisa rishta banaye jo sach mein meaningful ho.

Agar aapko lagta hai ki aap successful hai lekin andar se khaali mehsoos karte ho, ya agar aap struggle kar rahe ho apni potential ko pehchanne mein - toh ye kitaab, ye gyaan, aaj aapke liye hai.

Chaliye, shuru karte hain is safar ko - jo aapko sirf effective nahi, balki genuinely, deeply successful insaan banayega.

Stephen Covey ki kahani bhi kisi filmy kahani se kam nahi hai. Ye ek aisa insaan tha jisne apni zindagi ka ek bada hissa research karne mein bitaya - sirf ek sawaal ka jawab dhoondhne ke liye: "Success ka asli raaz kya hai?"

1970s ke daur mein, Covey ne pichle 200 saalon ki success literature ka gehraai se adhyayan kiya. Unhone dekha ki pehle ke 150 saalon mein, jo bhi kitaabein likhi gayi thi success ke baare mein, unme baat hoti thi character ki - integrity, humility, courage, patience jaise gunon ki. Lekin jaise jaise samay guzra, ek badlaav aaya. Pichle 50 saalon mein success literature "Personality Ethic" mein badal gayi - matlab ab log baat karne lage quick-fix techniques ki, image building ki, skills sikhne ki jo aapko successful "dikhaayein" - bina asli character develop kiye.

Ye discovery Covey ke liye ek turning point tha. Unhe realize hua ki hum sab ek aisi society mein reh rahe hain jahan hum shortcuts dhoondhte hain. Hum chahte hain ki humara business grow ho, lekin hum apni integrity develop nahi karna chahte. Hum chahte hain log humein respect karein, lekin hum genuinely trustworthy banna nahi chahte. Ye gap - iss gap ne Covey ko is kitaab likhne ke liye prerna di.

Covey khud ek professor the, ek father the, aur unhone apni zindagi mein kayi struggles dekhe the - apne bachon ke saath relationship mein, apne career mein, apne personal growth mein. Unhe samajh aaya ki temporary solutions kabhi permanent results nahi de sakte. Agar foundation kamzor hai, toh upar jo bhi banaoge, wo gir jaayega.

Isliye unhone decide kiya ki wo ek aisi kitaab likhenge jo sirf "kya karna hai" nahi sikhaayegi, balki "kaise sochna hai" ye sikhaayegi. Ye kitaab kisi ek technique ke baare mein nahi hai - ye ek complete paradigm shift ke baare mein hai. Ye kehti hai ki asli effectiveness bahar se nahi, andar se aati hai.

Yahi wajah hai ki "7 Habits of Highly Effective People" sirf ek business book nahi ban paayi, balki ek movement ban gayi - jo crores logon ki zindagi badal chuki hai, jo aaj bhi utni hi relevant hai jitni pehle din thi. Kyunki ye kitaab time-tested principles ki baat karti hai, trends ki nahi.

Toh chaliye, ab hum jaante hain is kitaab ki pehli aur sabse powerful habit ke baare mein - "Be Proactive." Ye sirf ek habit nahi hai, ye ek philosophy hai jeene ki.

Covey kehte hain ki har insaan ke saath jo bhi hota hai, uske aur uske response ke beech mein ek gap hota hai. Aur usi gap mein chhupi hoti hai humari asli freedom - freedom to choose. Ye choice hi decide karti hai ki hum reactive hain ya proactive.

Ek reactive insaan apni life ka control doosron ke haath mein de deta hai. Agar mausam kharab hai, uska mood kharab. Agar boss ne kuch bura bol diya, uska pura din barbaad. Wo hamesha kehta hai - "Mujhe majboor kiya gaya," "Mera koi control nahi hai," "Aisa hi hota hai." Ye words hi uski powerlessness ko show karte hain.

Lekin ek proactive insaan jaanta hai ki circumstances uski feelings decide nahi karti - uske values karte hain. Wo stimulus aur response ke beech mein ruk kar sochta hai, aur phir conscious choice karta hai.

Ek chhota sa example lijiye. Do log traffic jam mein phanse hain. Pehla insaan gussa ho jaata hai, horn bajata hai, apna blood pressure badha leta hai, aur ghar pahunch kar apne parivaar par bhi chidchidapan nikalta hai. Doosra insaan wahi traffic dekhta hai, lekin sochta hai - "Ye mere control mein nahi hai. Lekin main is time ka kya use kar sakta hoon?" Wo shayad ek achha podcast sunta hai, ya apne din ki planning karta hai. Same situation, do alag responses. Fark sirf itna hai ki dusre insaan ne apni proactive muscle ko train kiya hai.

Covey ka ek famous concept hai - "Circle of Concern" aur "Circle of Influence." Humari concern mein bahut saari cheezein aati hain - politics, mausam, doosron ka behavior. Lekin humara influence sirf un cheezon par hota hai jo hum khud control kar sakte hain - apni soch, apna reaction, apni mehnat. Jo log apni energy influence ke circle mein lagate hain, unka circle dheere-dheere badhta jaata hai. Aur jo log sirf concern mein ulझे rehte hain, wo aur bhi powerless mehsoos karne lagte hain.

Yahi hai pehla habit ka core message - aap apni zindagi ke author hain, victim nahi. Aur ye realization hi effectiveness ki pehli seedhi hai.

Ab baat karte hain doosre insight ki, jo pehle se bhi zyada gehra hai - "Begin with the End in Mind." Covey kehte hain ki har cheez do baar create hoti hai - pehle mind mein, phir reality mein. Jaise koi architect ghar banane se pehle uska naksha kaagaz par utaarta hai, waise hi ek effective insaan apni zindagi ka blueprint pehle apne dimaag mein banata hai.

Ek chhota sa example lijiye. Do log job start karte hain same company mein, same salary par. Ek insaan bas roz office jaata hai, kaam karta hai, ghar aata hai - koi clear direction nahi. Doosra insaan har din ka kaam apne long-term vision se connect karta hai - "Main yahan sirf paisa kamane nahi, ek skill build karne aaya hoon jo mujhe apni dream company tak le jaayegi." Paanch saal baad, dono ki zindagi bilkul alag dikhti hai. Farak talent ka nahi tha - farak tha clarity ka, ek clear "End" ka jo dimaag mein pehle se tha.

Covey ek powerful exercise batate hain - apni khud ki funeral imagine karo. Log wahan khade hain - family, dost, colleagues. Wo aapke baare mein kya kahenge? Kya wo kahenge ki aap ek achha insaan the, jisne rishtay nibhaaye, jisne apne principles se samjhauta nahi kiya? Ya sirf itna kahenge ki aap bahut busy the? Ye exercise darawana lagta hai, lekin ye asal mein ek mirror hai - jo aapko dikhata hai ki aap abhi kis direction mein badh rahe hain, aur kis direction mein badhna chahte hain.

Yahi hai is habit ka core - bina destination ke, koi bhi raasta aapko wahin le jaayega jahan waqt aur halaat le jaana chahenge. Lekin agar aapke paas ek clear "personal mission statement" hai - ek internal compass jo batata hai aapke liye success ka matlab kya hai - to har choti-badi decision us compass se align hoti hai.

Yaad rakhiye, busy hona aur effective hona do alag cheezein hain. Aap seedhi ko bahut tezi se chadh sakte hain, lekin agar wo seedhi galat deewar par tiki hai, to har kadam aapko galat jagah le jaayega. Isliye Covey kehte hain - pehle socho, "Main kahan pahunchna chahta hoon," tabhi decide karo, "Main wahan kaise pahunchunga." Yahi hai true effectiveness ki shuruaat - clarity se pehle, phir action.

Ab baat karte hain teesri habit ki, jo pehli do habits ko jodti hai action ke saath - "Put First Things First." Ye habit hai priority ki, discipline ki, aur us fark ki jo urgent aur important cheezon ke beech hota hai.

Covey ek simple lekin gehra concept dete hain - Time Management Matrix. Chaar quadrants hain. Pehla, jo urgent bhi hai aur important bhi - jaise koi deadline, koi crisis. Doosra, jo important hai lekin urgent nahi - jaise health, relationships, planning, learning. Teesra, jo urgent to lagta hai lekin important nahi - jaise baar baar aane wale phone calls, ya doosron ki chhoti-moti demands. Aur chautha, jo na urgent hai na important - bas time waste karne wali activities.

Covey kehte hain, jyadatar log apni zindagi quadrant ek aur teen mein hi guzaar dete hain - hamesha fire-fighting mein, hamesha reactive mode mein. Lekin jo log truly effective hote hain, wo apna maximum time quadrant do mein invest karte hain - jo important hai lekin urgent nahi. Kyunki yahi wo jagah hai jahan growth hoti hai, jahan preparation hoti hai, jahan aap future banate hain.

Ek chhota sa example lijiye. Socho ek student hai jo exam se ek din pehle raat bhar padhta hai, kyunki usne pehle kabhi time nahi nikala regular study ke liye. Ye hai quadrant ek ka life - hamesha stress mein, hamesha last moment ki daud. Lekin doosri taraf, ek student jo roz thoda thoda padhta hai, apni health ka khayal rakhta hai, apne goals plan karta hai - wo quadrant do mein reh raha hai. Uski zindagi mein calm hai, control hai, aur consistent progress hai.

Yahi farak hota hai reactive insaan aur proactive insaan ke beech. Jo log sirf urgent cheezon ke peeche bhaagte hain, wo hamesha thake hue rehte hain, lekin unki zindagi mein real progress kam hoti hai. Jo log important cheezon ko priority dete hain - chahe wo urgent na bhi ho - wo dheere dheere apni zindagi ko master karte hain.

Covey ka ye message bahut saaf hai - "Ye decide mat karo ki kya urgent hai, decide karo ki kya important hai, aur phir usko apni zindagi ka center bana do." Jab aap apni priorities is tarah set karte hain, tab hi aap wo seedhi sahi deewar par chadhte hain, jiski baat humne pehle ki thi. Effectiveness ka raaz yahi hai - important cheezon ko urgent hone se pehle hi apni zindagi mein jagah dena.

Ab zara ruk kar socho - ye saaton habits alag-alag tools nahi hain, ye ek complete transformation ka blueprint hain. Private victory se shuru hoti hai ye journey - jab aap proactive bante ho, jab apna end in mind rakhte ho, jab first things first karte ho. Uske baad public victory aati hai - win-win thinking, pehle samajhna phir samझe jaana, aur synergy ke through miracles create karna. Aur finally, saatvi habit - sharpen the saw - aapko continuously renew karti hai, taaki ye pura cycle rukta nahi, balki aur strong hota jaata hai.

Ye sirf ek book nahi hai dosto, ye ek mirror hai. Jo aapko dikhata hai ki aap abhi kahan khade ho, aur kya banne ki capacity aapke andar hai. Stephen Covey ne humein sikhaya hai ki real change bahar se nahi, andar se aata hai. Jab tak aap apne character ko strong nahi banate, koi bhi technique, koi bhi shortcut aapko permanent success nahi de sakta.

Socho zara - agar aap sirf ek habit bhi apni zindagi mein poori tarah utaar lein, agar aap sach mein proactive ban jaayein, apni responsibility uthana seekh jaayein, apne reactions ko control karna seekh jaayein - toh kitna kuch badal sakta hai. Aapke relationships, aapka career, aapki peace of mind - sab kuch.

Ye transformation raato-raat nahi hota. Ye ek daily practice hai, ek commitment hai apne aap se. Har din, har choice ke saath, aap decide karte ho ki aap kaun banna chahte ho.

Toh aaj se hi shuru karo. Ek habit chuno, usse apna banao, aur dekho kaise dheere-dheere aap wo insaan ban jaate ho jo highly effective hai - na sirf apne kaam mein, balki apni poori zindagi mein. Effectiveness koi destination nahi hai, ye ek way of living hai. Aur ye rasta aaj, isi pal se shuru hota hai.

Toh dosto, ab sirf sunna kaafi nahi hai - ab action lena hai. Is video ko yahin band mat karo aur bhool mat jaana. Ek habit uthao, aaj hi practice mein utaro, aur apne aap ko promise karo ki aap change karoge - dheere-dheere, lekin permanently.

Aur agar ye video aapke liye valuable raha, agar isne aapko kuch naya sochne pe majboor kiya, toh mujhe bataiye - is video ko like karo, apne dosto ke saath share karo jo apni life mein real change chahte hain. Aur agar aap abhi tak humare family ka hissa nahi bane, toh "Grow with Books" ko subscribe kar lo, bell icon dabana mat bhoolna - kyunki har hafte hum aise hi powerful books lekar aate hain jo aapki soch badal sakti hain, aapki zindagi badal sakti hain.

Yaad rakhna - kitaabein padhna kaafi nahi hai, unhe jeena padta hai. Stephen Covey ne humein ek raasta dikhaya hai, ab chalna hume hai. Toh commitment karo, discipline banao, aur duniya ko dikhao ki effectiveness sirf ek word nahi, ek lifestyle hai.

Milte hain agli video mein, ek naye safar ke saath. Tab tak ke liye - keep growing, keep becoming.
